title: creative.qa.evaluated
description: PAYLOAD of the `creative.qa.evaluated` envelope. Topic: creative.qa.evaluated. Emitted by creative-qa (§15.4) — the gate before an asset is launchable. Scores spec compliance, brand, compliance verdict, pre-flight performance band, and Entity-ID cluster risk on the 5-axis diversity rubric (concept/format/visual/hook/headline). verdict=passed is the spec's `creative.qa.passed` (§21/§5.1) expressed as a verdict so the single event carries pass|fix|block without a second event type (extend-never-mutate §6.2). A passed asset becomes eligible for campaign.compiled creative slots.

asset_ref.description: DAM asset id evaluated (the creative.generated asset_id).

verdict.description: Gate outcome. passed = launchable (the spec's creative.qa.passed); fix_suggested = Studio auto-applies the fix-list and re-evaluates; block = not launchable (policy/diversity fail).

compliance.description: Policy verdict from the compliance-engine (§10.9) with cited rule ids (e.g. RERA for real-estate, health-claim limits).

preflight_performance.description: Predicted performance band from the DNA-perf model (§15.4 pre-flight score).

diversity.description: Entity-ID cluster-risk scoring on the 5-axis rubric (§15.4). A set scoring <8/10 is blocked from launch (anti near-duplicate; Andromeda retrieval suppresses near-dupes, moat (2)).

near_duplicate_of.description: asset_ids this is too similar to (same first-4-token headline / same hero/backdrop / same 0-3s hook).

fix_list.description: Machine-readable fixes Studio auto-applies when verdict=fix_suggested (§15.4).
